title: The Orrery Itself
subtitle: form: orthogonal, with split handles
description: The frame that holds all of it, wired in with a split line:
`fromHandle` and `toHandle` are written together -- one alone is a
split with half a shape -- as `[along, across]` control points on
an orthogonal route. The heads run as a `stream` at `arrowDensity:
low`, sixty-four pixels apart, the sparsest the format goes.
Anchors say which rim a line meets. Handles say what it does on
